unit_note: USD millions. Investments of Federal Funds under Agriculture through Justice. Blank and less-than-500k (**) cells omitted. Ships 12 relations (6 monthly + 6 fiscal-year) against a sizing floor of 10, which it now clears. It was below floor while only the monthly roll-forward was declared; adjudicated 2026-08-18 against p29 and resolved the same day by declaring the fiscal-year roll-forward family-wide. Nothing was padded and no cell invented.
